# Swamp Meadow Community Theatre

> > Community theatre organization in Foster, Rhode Island producing plays, musicals, and youth productions with volunteer performers and directors.

Swamp Meadow Community Theatre (SMCT) is a volunteer-driven community theater based in Foster, RI, led by artistic leaders including Bob Hollis, Kaila Rubin, and Artie Robillard. The organization produces family-friendly shows, youth theatre programs, and hosts annual celebrations at venues like the Woody Lowden Recreation Center and Assembly Theatre.

- Swamp Meadow Community Theatre (SMCT)

- [Swamp Meadow Receives 5 Motif Nominations!](https://www.swampmeadow.org/news/swamp-meadow-receives-5-motif-nominations): SMCT receives 5 Motif Award nominations for Tom Sawyer and M*A*S*H

## Auditions & Casting

- [Urinetown Auditions](https://www.swampmeadow.org/audition/urinetown-auditions): Spring 2023 musical auditions at Assembly Theater in Harrisville, RI
- [Auditions for A Christmas Story](https://www.swampmeadow.org/calendar/auditions-for-a-christmas-story): Auditions for A Christmas Story production directed by Artie Robillard
- [Odyssey Speedrun Auditions](https://www.swampmeadow.org/audition/odyssey-speedrun-auditions): Summer auditions for youth Odyssey adaptation at Scituate Senior Center
- [Auditions for Foster Follies 2019](https://www.swampmeadow.org/audition/auditions-for-foster-follies-2019): Variety show auditions at Benjamin Eddy Building in Foster, RI

## Productions & Performances

- [Tending to Grace](https://www.swampmeadow.org/productions/tending-to-grace): November 2017 adaptation of Kimberly Newton Fusco novel with dual casts
- [Charlotte's Web 2021](https://www.swampmeadow.org/productions/charlottes-web-2): August 2021 outdoor performance of E.B. White classic at Foster Fair
- [Mr. Toad's Mad Adventures](https://www.swampmeadow.org/productions/mr-toads-mad-adventures): 2011 dual-cast youth production adapted from Wind in the Willows
- [The Best Christmas Pageant Ever](https://www.swampmeadow.org/productions/best-christmas-pageant): 2003 production of Barbara Robinson's Christmas play in Foster, RI
- [It's a Wonderful Life Performances](https://www.swampmeadow.org/calendar/its-a-wonderful-life-performances): Performance schedule for It's a Wonderful Life at Captain Isaac School
